crossRefs.note: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
translations.bsb: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
